title: Implement sell-rule shared evaluation contract and full-exit eligibility
description:
Build the shared SELL-rule layer on top of the phase j strategy SDK. Do not redefine the SDK.

In mike_trade/strategies/sell/base.py, define the SELL-specific evaluation contract.

1. Base class:
   - Create a SellRule abstract base, or a thin helper layer on the existing SellStrategy from mike_trade/strategies/base.py.
   - Concrete SELL plugins (vwap_breakdown, momentum_reversal, rsi_reversal) implement only their pure trigger logic.
   - Shared pre-checks run before that logic.

2. Immutable ExitLongRecommendation result type:
   - Only one action exists: EXIT_LONG.
   - The quantity is always the full confirmed remaining quantity of the managed position, as a Decimal.
   - Required fields: deterministic signal_id from make_signal_id, strategy_id, version, symbol, position/cycle identifier, triggering completed-bar UTC timestamp, and reason codes.
   - No field may hold a partial quantity, a confidence/probability score, an order type, or a broker reference.
   - A recommendation is advisory only. It never submits orders.

3. Full-exit eligibility evaluator, exposed as a pure function such as evaluate_exit_eligibility. It returns NO_SIGNAL / NOT_ELIGIBLE with explicit reason codes, never an exit, when:
   - the symbol is flat or has no owned managed long position (for example UNMANAGED, external, or never-filled)
   - the confirmed remaining quantity is zero or negative
   - the position is not long. SELL must never imply short or opposite-side trading.
   - the strategy is disabled/off
   - data is missing, stale, incomplete, or not warmed. Off/no data is NO_SIGNAL, not an implicit exit.
   - the ordinary-strategy minimum hold period has not elapsed. Use an injected clock/timestamp only and never wall-clock calls.

4. Exit-source classification. Define an ExitSource enum (for example PROTECTIVE_STOP, MANUAL_CLOSE, HARD_RISK, FORCED_LIQUIDATION, STRATEGY_SELL) and a helper that reports whether minimum hold applies.
   - Minimum hold applies only to STRATEGY_SELL.
   - Protective stops, manual close, hard risk exits, and configured forced liquidation bypass it.
   - Define a documented static priority ordering in which stop/manual/risk/forced exits outrank STRATEGY_SELL. Phase k.4 arbitration consumes this ordering.

5. Purity. Strategies receive no broker, secrets, filesystem, or network access. Use Decimal for all quantities and prices.

In tests/contracts/test_sell_strategy.py, write contract tests for:
- the full-quantity-only recommendation, including a partial-fill remaining quantity such as Decimal('7.5') yielding exactly that quantity
- rejection when flat, unmanaged, zero quantity, or short
- no-data/stale/disabled producing NO_SIGNAL
- minimum hold blocking STRATEGY_SELL only, with every other ExitSource bypassing it
- the priority ordering
- deterministic signal IDs
- the absence of confidence/order/broker fields
- a static import check that base.py imports no broker, adapter, persistence, HTTP, or secrets modules

Before editing, inspect:
- mike_trade/strategies/base.py
- mike_trade/strategies/registry.py
- tests/contracts/test_strategy_registry.py
- mike_trade/domain/signals.py
- mike_trade/domain/strategy_types.py
- mike_trade/domain/market.py
- mike_trade/market_data/context.py
- any existing position/lifecycle domain types under mike_trade/domain/

Decision budget: reuse existing domain types for side, signal, reason code, and position state. Add a new type only when none exists, and keep new public symbols to those listed in allowed_symbols.
acceptance_criteria: mike_trade/strategies/sell/base.py defines a SELL rule contract built on the existing SellStrategy/StrategySpec SDK, an immutable ExitLongRecommendation with action EXIT_LONG only, and a pure exit-eligibility evaluator.

ExitLongRecommendation quantity always equals the confirmed remaining long quantity as Decimal (including a fractional partial-fill remainder), and the type has no partial-quantity, confidence/probability, order-type, or broker field.
Flat, UNMANAGED/external, zero/negative-quantity, or non-long positions yield NO_SIGNAL/NOT_ELIGIBLE with explicit reason codes and never an exit or short recommendation.
Disabled strategies and missing/stale/incomplete/unwarmed data yield NO_SIGNAL with explicit reason codes, not an implicit exit.

Minimum hold blocks only ExitSource.STRATEGY_SELL. PROTECTIVE_STOP, MANUAL_CLOSE, HARD_RISK, and FORCED_LIQUIDATION bypass it, and the documented priority ordering ranks all of them above STRATEGY_SELL.
Minimum-hold evaluation uses only injected timestamps/clock, with no direct wall-clock calls.
Identical inputs produce identical signal IDs, and a different completed-bar timestamp produces a different ID.

tests/contracts/test_sell_strategy.py contains positive and negative tests for each criterion above plus a static check that base.py imports no broker/adapter/persistence/HTTP/secrets modules, and it passes when run in isolation.
forbidden_changes: change PLAN_SKELETON.json or other planning artifacts
introduce partial-exit quantities, short/opposite-side actions, auto re-buy, or confidence scores
give SELL rules broker, secrets, filesystem, or network access or let them submit orders
use float for money, price, or quantity values
create live broker orders or run broad test suites/backtests
